skills.detail:
When "No-Sword Style: Dragon Twister" is used, Skill 2 will transform into the Combo Skill "Bad Manners Kick Course" for a set period of time.
Skill 2 turns back into "No-Sword Style: Dragon Twister" after "Bad Manners Kick Course" is used or after a certain amount of time passes.

Zoro appears at close-range.
Zoro repeatedly deals percentage damage at long-range with a chance to Stun.
Knocks enemies back if Stun couldn't be applied.
Zoro will disappear after receiving a certain amount of damage, after a certain period of time, or if you use Skill 1.
Damage dealt will change based on the enemies' HP.
This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit.
